subject: PO gateway onboarding — payment tiers, PO routing, and early-pay safeguard
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@paybridge.io
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO gateway onboarding — payment tiers, PO routing, and early-pay safeguard

Hi Samantha / PayBridge team,

Thanks for starting the vendor onboarding process — excited to get PayBridge live. A couple of items we need to align before our finance team issues the first PO:

- Preferred billing cadence: do you invoice Net30 / Net45 / Net60? (we typically default to Net45 for new vendors but flexible).
- Early-pay option: would you be open to an early-pay program (Redwood-managed or marketplace-funded)? If so, what's the minimal fee you can accept for 7–14 day settlement?
- PO routing: confirm the exact recipient for the PO and whether we should include a reference/contract number on the invoice.
- Vendor portal fields: we need the completed onboarding form + W9 + bank details (ACH). I attached the onboarding form and W9 stub above.

Attachments: paybridge_onboarding_form.pdf, W9_PayBridge.pdf

Next steps: if you confirm Net terms and can share your preferred early-pay fee, I’ll loop in Finance (Karthik) to draft a PO that matches rollout timing.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Lo <s.lo@paybridge.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@paybridge.io
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO gateway onboarding — payment tiers, PO routing, and early-pay safeguard

Hi Irene (and team),

Appreciate the clear checklist. Quick answers:

- Standard: Net45. We typically ask Net45 while customers validate volumes; we can move to Net30 after two consecutive months of timely payment.
- Early-pay: PayBridge can accept early-pay at a 1.25% fee for 7-day settlement. We can be flexible down to 1.0% if Redwood handles the funding/marketplace program and guarantees payment timing.
- PO routing: please send PO to supplier-relations@paybridge.io and include the Redwood contract ID in the reference line.

I attached our vendor PO template and a short onboarding checklist so your AP team sees required fields. We will also upload our bank details and W9 to your vendor portal once we have the PO reference.

Attachments: vendor_po_template.docx

Thanks —
Samantha
Samantha Lo
Head of Revenue Operations
PayBridge Inc.
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lo <s.lo@paybridge.io>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO gateway onboarding — payment tiers, PO routing, and early-pay safeguard

On Fri, Oct 2, 2026 at 1:45 PM Samantha Lo <s.lo@paybridge.io> wrote:
> - Standard: Net45. We typically ask Net45 while customers validate volumes; we can move to Net30 after two consecutive months of timely payment.
> - Early-pay: PayBridge can accept early-pay at a 1.25% fee for 7-day settlement. We can be flexible down to 1.0% if Redwood handles the funding/marketplace program and guarantees payment timing.

Thanks for the quick reply, Samantha. Looping in AP to propose the operational approach. A suggested compromise to reduce back-and-forth and get you paid sooner:

1) Pilot terms: Net45 for the first 60 days (covers initial validation) with an automatic reassess at 60 days. If invoice performance is stable (no disputes, electronic invoicing accepted), move to Net30.
2) Early-pay pilot: Redwood will subsidize a portion of the early-pay fee for an initial 3-month pilot. Proposal: up to 30% of invoiced volume eligible for early pay at an effective fee of 0.75% (Redwood covers the delta vs your 1.25%). This keeps your economics close while lowering your cost of capital.
3) PO & reference: Please confirm PayBridge’s PO recipient (you noted supplier-relations@paybridge.io). We will issue a PO referencing the DocuSign MSA powerform (link below).

Action items for PayBridge: please return your completed onboarding form + finalized vendor PO template and W9. Once we have that, AP will issue a PO and enable the early-pay pilot in our billing system.

References: DocuSign MSA powerform: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc-msa-2026

Irene / Marissa / David — any objections to the pilot numbers above?

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Finance (Revenue Ops)
Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Lo <s.lo@paybridge.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO gateway onboarding — payment tiers, PO routing, and early-pay safeguard

Karthik / Irene — thanks, that structure works for us and is fair. We’ll do the following this week:

- Sign the DocuSign MSA powerform and return the signed copy. (I’ll send the signed PDF to supplier-relations@paybridge.io and upload to your portal.)
- Return completed onboarding_form + W9 + ACH remittance stub in one package.
- Confirm supplier-relations@paybridge.io as PO recipient and request that you add the DocuSign reference in the PO reference field.

Can you send the initial PO number when it’s issued? We’ll need that to complete portal onboarding and to trigger the early-pay eligibility flag. Also, can you share the short onboarding checklist (internal redwood steps) so our operations team can pre-fill fields to speed activation?

Attachments to follow from our side: signed_msa_signed.pdf, W9_PayBridge.pdf, bank_ach_remit.txt

Appreciate the quick cadence — looking forward to getting live.

Best,
Samantha
snippet: Align on Net45 pilot, early-pay subsidy (0.75%), PO routing to supplier-relations@paybridge.io; attachments: onboarding form, W9, vendor PO template.
